summary: LLM-free pre-run token-cost estimator + gate helper + subagent cost model gating seven expensive z-harness skills via one profile file and one cost_gate_decision event.

entry_points.summary: LLM-free CLI; estimate (pre-run envelope), forecast/--e2e-forecast (plan + projected execute), and subagent-costs (observed per-host/type USD breakdown); legacy positional mode backward-compatible; exit 0 on any producible output
Core estimator: loads profiles, resolves profile for command, computes static + dispatch-default/explicit + empirical tiers, applies static-floor clamp, returns envelope dict
Builds schema_version e2e_forecast.v1 with plan_component, execute_forecast_component, and total_forecast; execute may be a static low-confidence profile projection.

Reads metrics.jsonl tail (bounded), buckets by parent-run, filters to normally-completed runs (terminal event + non-excluded status + no cost_gate_decision{abandon}), computes p50/p90; returns None when insufficient data
Loads token-cost-profiles.json; uses data.get('profiles', {}); warns and returns {} on FileNotFoundError or JSONDecodeError (fail-open)
Match order: exact after stripping '/'; then try prepending 'z-'; returns (canonical_key, profile_dict|None)

Per-host, per-subagent_type cost breakdown from subagent_call events in metrics.jsonl; weights prompt_chars vs response_chars by per-model USD rates; prefers provider_input/output_tokens when present; labels source as provider|chars
USD/1M-token rate table for Claude (haiku/sonnet/opus), OpenAI (gpt-4o/mini/gpt-4/gpt-3.5), Google (gemini/flash/pro), DeepSeek families; SOLID: pricing lives only here
Resolves metrics.jsonl path: Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR > bash plan-path.sh base_dir (external base, 10s timeout) > legacy <repo>/z-harness/metrics.jsonl

Gate driver: estimate -> delegate disposition to config.py check-no-ask -> render human_block -> emit single JSON {disposition, estimate, human_block}; fail-open (estimator/config errors produce fallback envelope/disposition); stdout is pure JSON; stderr for diagnostics

5-subcommand mechanical plumbing for /z-plan's hard gate, extracted from skills/z-plan/SKILL.md at T113 (skill-overhaul-phase1 #9): compute-dispatch, call-gate, apply-reduction, build-decision-json, halt-finalize; judgment-dense prose stays in SKILL.md
Computes the 7 ZPLAN_DISPATCH_* counts + ZPLAN_COST_APPROVED_INTENT_LEVEL_MAX from --planning-mode/--intent-level-config/--docs-index-exists; prints export lines

Calls pre-run-cost-gate.sh, normalizes the single JSON envelope, applies sanitized-error degrade (NO_ASK set -> halt, else -> ask); reused for initial gate call AND every reduction re-estimate; prints export GATE_* lines
Prints authoritative-state export lines for force_l2_standard/force_l1_quick driver reduction; exit 2 on unrecognized token

Prints single-line cost_gate_decision JSON; command/choice/estimated_tokens/confidence/basis/disposition/choice_source/gate_id unconditional, rule_id/range_high/attempt_count/reason conditional on non-empty arg
Sets run-brief outcome/next for a cost-gate halt, then calls z-teardown.sh --status aborted (release-before-deregister owned by z-teardown.sh)

Reference tables extracted at T113, included into skills/z-plan/SKILL.md via <!-- include: --> at the terminal cleanup helper: telemetry field reference, cleanup matrix, sanitized helper-error expansion; never restated inline in SKILL.md
Profile registry: schema_version 1; hard profiles for z-research, z-plan-split, and z-plan; z-plan defines dispatch_defaults/dispatch_contract plus a low-confidence execute e2e_forecast component
[Cost gate] Enum question_id in DEFAULTS workflow block; default 'ask'; valid values ask|auto_proceed|halt
[Cost gate] Integer budget knob; default None (unset); NOT a question_id; validator _validate_positive_int_or_none; coercer converts string env values to int

[Cost gate] Registered question_id; choices {ask, auto_proceed, halt}; skill_default ask; halt_category risk; callsites: scripts/pre-run-cost-gate.sh, skills/z-research, skills/z-plan-split, skills/z-plan

[Cost gate] Budget-aware resolver invoked by check-no-ask when --range-high and --severity are both provided; soft always auto_proceed; hard+interactive returns ask; hard+NO_ASK=halt runs overnight allowlist first, then falls through to the budget rule (range_high vs cost.token_budget); unhandled_gate when policy mode + gate not covered; returns {result, rule_id}

check-no-ask CLI entrypoint; when --range-high/--severity given, delegates to _resolve_cost_gate (cost-gate path); otherwise generic overnight-override path (paths 1-4, unknown_ask_blocked on unregistered qid)

/z-plan hard gate before every expensive Agent dispatch (planning-router, intent-classifier, doc-fetcher, Explore, Phase 3/7 consultants, task-tree-generator); computes 7 documented dispatch keys via scripts/zplan-cost-gate-runtime.sh compute-dispatch, calls the same script's call-gate subcommand (wraps pre-run-cost-gate.sh), delegates budget/no-ask policy to config.py

Defines the extended cost_gate_decision payload (disposition, choice_source, gate_id, rule_id, range_high, attempt_count, reason) and the emit_zplan_cost_gate_decision_once single-emission helper, which calls scripts/zplan-cost-gate-runtime.sh build-decision-json

Bounded reduction loop (ZPLAN_COST_REESTIMATE_MAX=2); reducible drivers limited to force_l2_standard/force_l1_quick (intent_level_depth, phase3_consultants only), mutated via scripts/zplan-cost-gate-runtime.sh apply-reduction; emits cost_gate_reestimate_attempt for nonterminal attempts; intent-mode only

Thin wrapper: calls scripts/zplan-cost-gate-runtime.sh halt-finalize (sets run-brief outcome/next, then scripts/z-teardown.sh --status aborted for release-before-deregister). Equivalent to the prior inline function body.

invariants: estimate-tokens.py exits 0 on any producible envelope; exit 1 only when required positional arg is missing
Estimator is fail-open: FileNotFoundError on profiles or metrics returns a usable (possibly zeroed) envelope
Static-floor clamp: estimated_tokens = max(static_low + dispatch_add, round(p50)); range_low is never lowered by empirical; range_high = max(static_high + dispatch_add, round(p90))
pre-run-cost-gate.sh stdout is a single JSON object {disposition, estimate, human_block}; all diagnostics go to stderr only
pre-run-cost-gate.sh delegates disposition to config.py check-no-ask (single authority); it never reimplements the budget rule in bash
Soft gate always resolves to auto_proceed (rule_id: soft_gate) regardless of budget/NO_ASK

Hard gate with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt checks the overnight allowlist BEFORE the budget rule; only a non-positive overnight result (ask/no_ask_halt/no_ask_blocked) falls through to the budget comparison
Hard gate with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt, allowlist miss, and no budget set returns halt (rule_id: cost_budget_missing) — fail-closed
Hard gate with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt and range_high missing returns halt (rule_id: cost_estimate_missing) — never silently auto_proceeds
budget <= 0 after coercion returns halt (rule_id: cost_budget_invalid); validator should catch it at write time but defense-in-depth applies
In benchmark/policy mode (_is_policy_mode()), allowlist miss + range_high > budget returns unhandled_gate rather than halt — loud abort for policy coverage gaps
cost.token_budget is NOT in QUESTION_IDS; it is a plain config knob; _run_startup_guards() must NOT reference it
workflow.pre_run_cost_gate IS in QUESTION_IDS, VALIDATORS, and RESULT_MAP; _run_startup_guards() asserts this at module load
cost_gate_decision event is emitted by the CALLER (skill), not by the gate helper; one terminal event per gate invocation
cost_gate_decision with choice:abandon is the empirical filter signal; those parent runs are excluded from future p50/p90 computation
Gate fires AFTER run_start so cost_gate_decision attributes to the run
Empirical tier excludes: in-flight runs (latest_ts within 5 min of max_ts), terminal status in {aborted_by_user, halted, errored}, runs with cost_gate_decision{choice:abandon}
Parent-run rollup: events bucketed by effective_run = parent_run_id if present else run; child tokens accumulate into parent bucket
Both run_start and run_end top-level events carry a command field (Phase-7 stamping); empirical attribution prefers event command field over kind-inference (_KIND_TO_COMMAND fallback)
Z_HARNESS_COST_TAIL_LINES (default 2000 for estimate, 5000 for subagent-costs) and Z_HARNESS_COST_MIN_SAMPLES (default 3) control empirical tier behavior via env vars

No-profile envelope (_no_profile_envelope): confidence=low, range [0,0], range_high=0, gate=null, basis='no profile', estimated_tokens=0; distinct from gate fallback envelope (estimator unavailable) which sets range_high=null
OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT does NOT include workflow.pre_run_cost_gate; operators must opt in via OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE or direct config
D2 (wide x HEAVY suppression): when WIDE_N > 3, brainstorm treats run as MEDIUM and skips HEAVY fan-out; wide and HEAVY never multiply
Subagent-costs pricing lives only in _DEFAULT_MODEL_RATES (SOLID); raw telemetry keeps prompt_chars/response_chars separate per D9
_default_metrics_path resolves external base via plan-path.sh base_dir subprocess (10s timeout); falls back to legacy in-repo path on failure
estimate-tokens.py forecast and estimate --e2e-forecast emit schema_version e2e_forecast.v1 with plan_component, execute_forecast_component, and total_forecast; /z-plan gates only the plan component

Profiles may declare dispatch_defaults; explicit non-negative dispatch values replace defaults for the same key, duplicate explicit values are summed before replacement, and unknown keys warn/are ignored

/z-plan is a hard workflow.pre_run_cost_gate callsite and runs the gate before planning-router, intent-classifier, doc-fetcher, Explore, consultant panels, task-tree-generator, or any other expensive Agent dispatch
/z-plan emits exactly one terminal cost_gate_decision per run; nonterminal cost-reduction attempts emit cost_gate_reestimate_attempt instead

/z-plan cost_gate_decision carries the extended fields disposition, rule_id, range_high, choice_source, attempt_count, and optional reason, in addition to the common command/choice/estimated_tokens/confidence/basis fields
/z-plan reduction loop is capped at ZPLAN_COST_REESTIMATE_MAX=2 attempts; only force_l2_standard and force_l1_quick are reducible, and only in PLANNING_MODE=intent
/z-plan's reduction loop counter and event shape (cost_gate_reestimate_attempt) are independent of /z-research's 3-loop-back change_dispatch counter; they are not interchangeable

No pre-gate Agent dispatch invariant: hard-gated skills (z-plan, z-research, z-plan-split) may only run deterministic Artifact Scout inventory before the hard gate resolves; the artifact-scout Agent classifier is strictly post-gate

z-plan cost_gate_decision payload (build-decision-json) unconditionally includes gate_id (<RUN>:z-plan:pre-subagent-cost-gate, same id correlates cost_gate_reestimate_attempt); command/choice/estimated_tokens/confidence/basis/disposition/choice_source are also unconditional; rule_id/range_high/attempt_count/reason remain conditional on non-empty arg

T113 extraction (skill-overhaul-phase1 #9): /z-plan's mechanical cost-gate plumbing lives in scripts/zplan-cost-gate-runtime.sh (5 subcommands) and _fragments/zplan-cost-gate-reference.md (telemetry/cleanup-matrix reference); skills/z-plan/SKILL.md keeps only judgment-dense prose and thin wrapper functions that call the script's subcommands; behavioral invariants (exactly-once cost_gate_decision, nonterminal cost_gate_reestimate_attempt, raw helper JSON never logged, release-before-deregister ordering) are preserved verbatim per the script's own header comment
gotchas: Z_HARNESS_COST_TOKEN_BUDGET string env value must coerce to int; the coercer in _COERCERS handles this; if coercion fails at repo/env layer, config.py exits 2 (hard fail, not soft warn)
workflow.pre_run_cost_gate=halt in TOML halts ALL hard-gate commands unconditionally including interactive sessions
--range-high missing in check-no-ask cost-gate path means estimate unavailable: interactive returns ask, overnight returns halt(cost_estimate_missing); never silently auto_proceeds
The brainstorm multiplier in z-research profile assumes a non-HEAVY brainstorm sub-run; HEAVY sub-runs cost more but there is no per-invocation budget override (change-dispatch is the lever)
Soft gates fire only on HEAVY classification path for z-brainstorm and z-audit; LIGHT/MEDIUM runs skip the gate entirely

z-research has a 3-loop-back cap on change_dispatch; if COST_GATE_LOOPBACKS > 3 the gate falls through to Abandon; this is a SEPARATE counter/event shape from /z-plan's ZPLAN_COST_REESTIMATE_MAX=2 loop
cost_gate_decision is the single canonical event name across all seven gating skills; do not emit command-specific legacy variants
empirical token counting uses subagent_input_tokens + subagent_output_tokens; falls back to prompt_chars/4 + response_chars/4; events with neither field contribute 0 tokens
The empirical tier counts ALL events in the parent bucket (including child subagent events); this is intentional — it reflects the full run cost including sub-dispatches
In-flight grace window is 5 minutes (300s): if a run's latest event is within 5 min of the file's global max_ts, it is considered in-flight and excluded regardless of terminal event presence
_KIND_TO_COMMAND maps generic run_start/run_end to z-plan as best-effort for pre-T001 legacy events; pre-T001 z-research events will be misattributed to z-plan in the empirical tier
_no_profile_envelope returns range_high=0; the gate fallback envelope (when estimator binary missing/failing) returns range_high=null; callers check for null to detect estimate-unavailable
Wide-mode conversational gate (Phase 2c, WIDE_N > 3) in z-brainstorm is a separate inline prose estimate — NOT backed by pre-run-cost-gate.sh
subagent-costs pricing rates are approximate for native Claude subagents (chars/4); only external CLIs producing provider_input_tokens/provider_output_tokens give exact accounting
After the Phase-D external-base flip, legacy in-repo z-harness/metrics.jsonl may be stale; Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR env override is the reliable escape hatch if plan-path.sh subprocess fails
Plan+execute forecasts are approximate and prospective; execute_forecast_component is a wide low-confidence projection for later /z-execute and is not a cap
/z-plan dispatch_defaults are intentionally fail-closed because route/depth/doc/explore/consult fan-out may not be known before the gate

/z-plan reduction is offered only in PLANNING_MODE=intent; legacy planning_mode=full has no reduction option in this loop (abandon + rerun with explicit flag/config is the only path to a different mode)

zplan_cost_gate_halt_finalize invokes scripts/render-cost-summary.py on halt to render a cost summary from events.jsonl; that script is wired into the /z-plan cost-gate path but is NOT one of this concept's tracked source files
All seven gating skills now live at skills/<name>/SKILL.md; the pre-Phase-D commands/*.md layout referenced in older docs no longer exists
Post-run subagent-costs is retrospective observed-call accounting (provider tokens when present, char-est otherwise); do not treat it as the same surface as pre-run forecasts

call-gate is invoked identically for the initial gate call and every reduction re-estimate (same normalize/sanitize logic); do not duplicate this logic inline in SKILL.md — SKILL-STYLE.md's 'second consumer' rule is why it is a script

_fragments/zplan-cost-gate-reference.md's own field-list bullets for cost_gate_decision do not explicitly mention gate_id even though build-decision-json always emits it; trust the script over that prose bullet list for the exact payload shape

envelope_schema.estimated_tokens: <int; static_low+dispatch when no empirical; max(static_low+dispatch, p50) when empirical>
envelope_schema.range_low: <int; static_low + dispatch_add; never lowered by empirical>
envelope_schema.range_high: <int; 0 for no-profile; null only in gate fallback envelope when estimator unavailable>

cost_gate_decision_event.choice: proceed | auto_proceed | change_dispatch | abandon | halt | interrupted

z_plan_extended_fields.reason: gate_policy_halt | unhandled_gate | helper_invocation_failure | malformed_helper_json | missing_estimate_fields | user_abandoned | user_wait_interrupted (optional)

workflow.pre_run_cost_gate.description: Controls hard-gate AskUser behavior for profiled commands including /z-plan. ask=prompt; auto_proceed=skip prompt after helper approval; halt=unconditional halt.

cost.token_budget.description: Token ceiling for overnight/no-ask hard-gate resolution, applied after the overnight allowlist check. range_high <= budget -> auto_proceed; range_high > budget -> halt or unhandled_gate (policy mode); unset -> halt(cost_budget_missing)

z-brainstorm.fires_on: HEAVY path only (step 1a); wide WIDE_N>3 uses separate inline prose gate (Phase 2c)

z-plan.fires_on: pre-subagent gate in skills/z-plan/SKILL.md ('Pre-subagent cost gate (hard)'), before any expensive Agent dispatch

e2e_forecast_schema.plan_component: pre-run estimate envelope component for the command being gated
e2e_forecast_schema.execute_forecast_component: projected post-plan execution component; for z-plan this is static low-confidence wide fallback from token-cost-profiles.json
e2e_forecast_schema.total_forecast: plan + execute component sums; approximate, not exact, not a hard cap
